reason: I'd ask Claude for the draft first and only pay a person if it's not good enough. Paying 55 USDC for a pool where everyone but the winner works for free feels like spec work, and I'd be funding it in crypto on an unaudited new product I can't get through my org's finance.
objection: Everyone who doesn't win works for free, which feels like spec work, and I'd be locking real money in USDC on Solana with a team that has no audit and no track record. I don't know if an AI judge's rubric score matches what I'd actually call good.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial where I see real entries judged against my rubric and the winning one clearly beats what Claude gives me, plus a way to pay by card and a reference from another organiser who used it.
